title: Great curtain especially for the price
text: Great curtain especially for the price. This may not be a black out curtain, but it blocks the light and keeps the air away as though it is one. I would highly recommend. The width is also appreciated.

product_metadata.title: NICETOWN Room Darkening Curtain Panel - (52 inches W x 108 inches L, Teal Blue, 1 Panel) Toddler Boy Bedroom Drape with Grommet Top, Energy Smart Window Treatment Curtain
features: ELEGANT DESIGN: 1-panel BLACKOUT CURTAIN per package. Each Curtain Panel measures 52" wide x 108" long. The NICETOWN drapery is constructed with gorgeous matte silver grommets, fitting the curtain rod of your choice up to 1.6 inches in diameter, making the curtains easy to install and slide.

AMAZING MATERIAL: This unique, soft, and heavy-duty blackout fabric is woven with three-layer construction. The middle layer of black yarns creates a curtain panel that is excellent for blocking out 85%-99% of light (Dark color works better on blocking light) while providing privacy.

MULTIFUNCTION: These Blackout Window Curtain Blind will prevent harmful light from reaching your floors and furniture, efficiently prevents cold or heat transfer from outside, will increase the energy efficiency of your home, and allow you to create darkness at any time of day.

GOOD CHOICE: Perfect drapery option for anyone seeking to block daylight, take a nap, or keep sun glare off your TV. Besides, you can choose blackout valance and sheer curtains in the NICETOWN store to match. Such curtain sets provide a more permanent harmonious window dressing.

EASY CARE: Good-quality finishing will withstand years of use. Machine washable and Wash the water temperature below 86F. Mild detergent no bleaching. Low-temperature ironing. Don’t use sharp things scratching curtains.
